description: Analyze a brand name's strength WITHOUT checking the register — read-only, offline, deterministic (same name always gives the same result). Returns JSON with the distinctiveness spectrum (fanciful / arbitrary / suggestive / descriptive / generic), phonetic collisions to check, and a checklist (other-language meanings, common-law use, state registers). Optional goodsDescription (what you sell) sharpens the analysis: a descriptive word for those goods scores weaker than the same word for unrelated goods. No live data and no register results — pair it with screen_trademark, which checks the actual federal register. Use this to judge how protectable a name is; use screen_trademark to judge whether it conflicts.

goodsDescription.description: What you sell, e.g. 'music streaming app' — sharpens the distinctiveness analysis for those goods; omit for a name-only read

name.description: Proposed brand name to analyze, e.g. NOVABREW

name: analyze_name
